mapper.insert: insert into tb_qc_proc_test_mst (work_batch_id, qc_test_type, tester_id, test_state, reg_id, upd_id) values (#{workBatchId}, #{qcTestType}, #{testerId}, #{testState}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select a.item_cd ,i.item_name ,b.make_no ,b.lot_no ,b.lot_no2 ,l.client_name ,id.display_capacity ,c.tester_id ,d.prod_date ,b.batch_status ,c.qc_test_type ,c.etc ,a.work_batch_id ,c.qc_proc_test_mst_id ,id.capping_range ,id.charging_cnt ,id.essence_std ,id.work_flow from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on b.work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id join tb_qc_proc_test_mst c on c.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = a.item_cd join tb_item_detail id on id.item_cd = i.item_cd join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST m on a.work_order_id = m.work_order_id left join tb_client_mst l on l.client_id = m.client_id left join TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC d on d.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id and d.proc_cd = 'PRC002' where b.work_batch_id = #{workBatchId} and a.proc_cd = #{procCd}

select b.sample_date ,b.qty1 ,b.qty2 ,b.qty3 ,b.qty4 ,b.qty5 ,b.qty6 ,b.qty7 ,b.qty8 ,b.qty9 ,b.qty1+b.qty2+b.qty3+b.qty4+b.qty5+b.qty6+b.qty7+b.qty8+b.qty9 as totQty ,b.qc_proc_test_mst_id ,b.qc_proc_test_sample_id from tb_qc_proc_test_sample b where b.qc_proc_test_mst_id = #{qcProcTestMstId}

select a.test_item ,a.test_method ,b.test_result ,b.tester_id ,a.order_dist ,b.qc_proc_test_mst_id ,b.qc_proc_test_method_id from tb_proc_test_type_method a left join tb_qc_proc_test_method b on a.test_type = b.test_type and a.order_dist = b.order_dist and b.qc_proc_test_mst_id = #{qcProcTestMstId} where a.test_type = #{testType} order by a.order_dist

select b.test_time ,b.line1 ,b.line2 ,b.line3 ,b.line4 ,b.line5 ,b.line6 ,b.line7 ,b.line8 ,b.line9 ,b.line10 ,b.pass_yn ,b.order_dist ,b.test_type ,b.qc_proc_test_mst_id ,b.qc_proc_test_detail_id from tb_qc_proc_test_detail b where b.qc_proc_test_mst_id = #{qcProcTestMstId} and b.test_type = #{testType}

select b.test_type ,b.line_name ,b.scale_cd ,c.scale_nickname ,b.order_dist ,b.qc_proc_test_mst_id ,b.qc_proc_test_line_id from tb_qc_proc_test_line b left join tb_scale_mst c on b.scale_cd = c.scale_cd where b.qc_proc_test_mst_id = #{qcProcTestMstId} and b.test_type = #{testType}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_qc_proc_test_sample (qc_proc_test_mst_id , sample_date, qty1,qty2,qty3,qty4,qty5,qty6,qty7,qty8,qty9,reg_id, upd_id) values ( #{qcProcTestMstId} , #{sampleDate}, #{qty1}, #{qty2}, #{qty3}, #{qty4}, #{qty5}, #{qty6}, #{qty7}, #{qty8}, #{qty9}, #{userId}, #{userId})

insert into tb_qc_proc_test_method (qc_proc_test_mst_id , test_type, test_item, test_method, test_result, tester_id, order_dist, reg_id, upd_id) values ( #{qcProcTestMstId} , #{testType}, #{testItem}, #{testMethod}, #{testResult}, #{testerId}, #{orderDist}, #{userId}, #{userId})

insert into tb_qc_proc_test_detail (qc_proc_test_mst_id , test_type, test_time, line1,line2,line3,line4,line5,line6,line7,line8,line9,line10, order_dist, pass_yn, reg_id, upd_id) values ( #{qcProcTestMstId} , #{testType}, #{testTime}, #{line1}, #{line2}, #{line3}, #{line4}, #{line5}, #{line6}, #{line7}, #{line8}, #{line9}, #{line10}, #{orderDist }, #{passYn}, #{userId}, #{userId})

insert into tb_qc_proc_test_line (qc_proc_test_mst_id , test_type, line_name, scale_cd, order_dist, reg_id, upd_id) values ( #{qcProcTestMstId} , #{testType}, #{lineName}, #{scaleCd}, #{orderDist}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select a.work_batch_id ,a.qc_test_type ,b.batch_status ,a.etc ,a.tester_id from tb_qc_proc_test_mst a join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on a.work_batch_id = b.work_batch_id where qc_proc_test_mst_id = #{qcProcTestMstId}

select a.work_start_time ,a.work_end_time ,a.order_qty as orderQty ,b.charging_cnt ,b.capping_range ,b.essence_std from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a left join tb_item_detail b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd where a.work_batch_id = #{workBatchId} and a.proc_cd = #{procCd}
